primary_finding: For the explicit actual all-seven-width stable box in checkpoints 036-037 and every box with each endpoint independently perturbed by less than 10^-10000, the minimum number of denominator coefficient intervals violated by an unrestricted common MONIC numerator is EXACTLY FIVE. Five separately verified positive actual-atom sums force every common numerator's b2,b3,b4,b5,b6 strictly above the respective own upper endpoints. The anchor lower bounds are respectively 11000,211000,1000000,2150,909; the explicit-neighborhood weaker bounds 10500,210000,900000,2140,900 still exceed the own endpoints. The sums have one positive target coordinate each and all other coordinates through b6 nonpositive; all common numerators are Hurwitz and have strictly positive coefficients. Five independent Cramer/determinant sign checks preserve these certificates on the neighborhood.
sharpness_witness: The single monic numerator (149999/50,15007499/50,1467398223/100,6031551/25,4801697/2,247137/100,153011/100,1) works on every box in that same neighborhood, while b0 and b1 remain strictly inside their corresponding own intervals. An independently written direct-monomial/affine-substitution checker verified all 752 positive compactified Bernstein coefficients on 94 leaves, lower bound >10^-10, and >1/100 interior margins for b0,b1. Hence exactly five rather than only at least five interval escapes are proved within this scoped family.
remaining_gap: These are necessary bounds and a positive example, not an all-negative-coordinate atom vector; the original unrestricted decision remains open. The fixed-b0,b1 upper-endpoint tangent ansatz succeeded on several sampled boundary shapes but failed at a sixth, so it is not a general proof.
next_action: Seek an unrestricted negative certificate on a different eligible box, or a general constructive proof not restricted to endpoint spans, retained parities, or fixed upper b0/b1.
